0022600007.text: The Denver Nuggets open their 2026-27 season on the road against the Oklahoma City Thunder, who have not yet played a game this season. Denver's Spencer Jones is day-to-day with a hamstring issue and is a game-time decision, while Oklahoma City's Otega Oweh is out after Achilles surgery, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Nuggets a 25% chance to win. In the 2025-26 season series, the Nuggets lost 1-3, but they won the most recent meeting 127-107 in Denver on April 10.
